items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Terminology 49:1
items.html: The sorting that is done by the force of the 32 paths of Hochma, which sorts the 288 sparks alone and bestows them upon Bina, is made in the secret of the 32 Elokim of the Act of Creation, which indicate the sorting of the 288. For in the name Elokim [86] the letters Mi [50] and Eleh [36] are discerned: Mi is the secret of the GAR that are included from the sparks inside Bina, and Eleh is the secret of the VAK of the sparks that are included inside Bina. These hint at the first nine Sefirot in each and every path of the 32 paths that were sorted to the side of holiness. But the Malchuts in each and every path became waste below and could not be sorted, as above in answers 15 and 16. (Page 871, Item 15).
